observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locator «p. 114.» (L14) in the left margin. The count of the lines runs through the spaces and the heads of chapters 38 and 39: 5 stands in the space between L3 and the head of chapter 38, beside no line; 30 beside the head of chapter 39.
body L4-L5, L24-L26: the heads of the chapters are set in a larger type and centred; the title of chapter 39 is in two lines.
body L3, L13: the letters of the references (a) are bold italic; the (a) of L3 belongs to chapter 37, that of L13 to chapter 38, where the letters begin again.
body L1: the first two words are printed faint, their letters broken.
body L19: the t of «descendet» is printed broken, like an l.
notes_right L2: «Ptolemaeum» is not letter-spaced here.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
